Michelle, saw Filevine raise $400M and launch the LOIS Console, with AI revenue up around 130% year over year.

Growth that fast usually surfaces RevOps's signal-to-action gap: buying signals land but reps cannot research, write, and follow up fast enough to act on them. Our AI SDR closes that loop autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Michelle, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot quantify the lift from fixing follow-up until they see it. Our best-practice changes alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of Filevine's current outbound, three things I would change, and how each maps to measurable pipeline lift without adding headcount.

Michelle, last bit of proof for Filevine.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other well-funded SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
